messages:
sara: Thanks everyone for a great all-hands today! Recording + slides here: https://redwood.ai/allhands/2026-03-23 (slides: https://redwood.ai/slides/ah-mar2026.pdf). I'll capture the live Q&A, short answers, and owners below. If I missed anything, ping me. :wave:

devon: Quick SLA follow-up — when are we aiming for 99.9% for Dedicated endpoints? Asked during the infra update.

sara: Short answer: targeting 99.9% SLO for core endpoints by end of Q3. Pilot customers will be onboarded starting in June; full GA depends on scale test results and capacity.

anya: For Private (on-prem) — any change to expected maintenance/upgrade windows? Customer needs a max 1-day outage window.

tanvi: We heard that during the session. Private v1 supports in-place upgrades with <1h downtime for minor patches; major version upgrades may require a maintenance window. I'll write up exact upgrade options and timelines.

jia: Observability retention question that came up: is longer retention (eg 12mo traces) going to be an add-on? Customers asked for that.

kevin: Confirming: long-term traces are planned as an add-on. Default console retention is 30d. We're finalizing pricing tiers — cc @sara @tanvi.

sara: Action items (short):
1) tanvi -> doc on Private upgrade plans + maintenance windows (owner: @tanvi; due: 2026-04-06)
2) devon -> run infra scale test checklist and share results (owner: @devon; due: 2026-04-02)
3) jia & kevin -> draft public pricing note for extended observability retention (owners: @jia @kevin; due: 2026-04-09)
I'll create a GH issue and link it here.

ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://storage.redwood.ai/allhands/1840509876/recording.mp4 :white_check_mark:

devon: I'll start the infra scale run tomorrow and post a short summary in #eng-sre. cc @kevin for capacity planning.

tanvi: Draft for Private upgrade doc is live: https://docs.redwood.ai/private-upgrades-draft (please add comments).

anya: Thanks — can you add a customer-friendly TL;DR one-pager? They prefer a single paragraph summary.

tanvi: :thumbsup: Will add a 1-paragraph TL;DR at the top and a visible maintenance matrix.

jia: For pricing note, proposing tiers: 30d default, 90d mid, 12mo premium. I'll share ballpark numbers early next week for review.

sara: Great. If you want to be added to the owners list for any item above, reply here. I'll update the GH issue, ping sales/solutions, and post a short email summary.

kevin: Can we also add a 5-minute demo clip highlighting Dedicated latency numbers? Sales asked for a short script.

sara: Good idea — @devon, can you record a 5-min latency demo as part of the scale test? :calendar:

devon: Yep — adding demo recording to the scale-test checklist and will post the clip link when done.

sara: Thanks all — will follow up once GH issue is created and owners are assigned. :eyes:
